# CaulHaus

> CaulHaus builds custom capacity planning, resource allocation, and sales-to-delivery automations directly inside Google Workspace and existing project tools for 20–150 person agencies, consultancies, and professional services firms.

## Overview
CaulHaus is a delivery operations and workflow automation practice led by founder Alex Herbstman, a systems architect and developer with over a decade of experience connecting tools and automating operational workflows—including three years building enterprise resource and capacity automation systems via an extended network inside one of the largest technology organizations in the world. Alex leads every engagement directly, architecting and writing core automations, backed by a vetted bench of senior specialists when a build requires specialized platform expertise or extra bandwidth.

Growing agencies and consultancies lose hundreds of billable hours every month reconciling fragile staffing spreadsheets, chasing Friday status updates in Slack, and manually copying closed-won deal details from their CRM into project boards. Buying bloated PSA software ($50/seat/month) rarely fixes the problem because delivery teams refuse to update yet another tool. CaulHaus builds custom capacity engines and cross-tool automations natively inside Google Workspace, your CRM, and your existing project management stack—with zero new per-seat software fees.

## The 4-Stage Connected Delivery Lifecycle We Automate
1. Sales-to-Delivery Handoffs (CRM -> Project Spin-Up): When a deal closes in HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive, we automatically provision Google Drive folders, project boards, billing milestones, and staffing requests in Slack.
2. Resource & Capacity Planning (Flagship Engine): We replace brittle staffing workbooks with a custom Google Workspace + Apps Script capacity planner featuring automated roster sync, role-based access views, and live utilization dashboards.
3. Automated Weekly Status & Workload Rollups: We eliminate the Friday afternoon Slack status chase by pulling task and workload progress from Asana, Jira, ClickUp, Linear, or Sheets into automated Monday leadership digests.
4. Delivery-to-Finance & Utilization Reporting: Completed project milestones automatically trigger billing notifications or draft invoices in Stripe/QuickBooks and update leadership utilization reports.

## How We Work (/services/)
1. The 2-Week Workflow & Capacity Audit: A focused two-week diagnostic to map sales-to-delivery handoffs, quantify utilization and spreadsheet time loss, deliver a prioritized technical roadmap, and deploy your first working automation prototype (100% of the audit fee is credited toward a Full System Build kicked off within 30 days).
2. Full Capacity & System Build (4–6 Weeks): End-to-end engineering and rollout of your custom Google Workspace capacity planner and cross-tool automation pipelines on production data.
3. Continuous Operations & Capacity Partner (Monthly Retainer): Ongoing partnership offered in two tiers—Core Systems & Capacity Continuity (monthly roster/rate calibration, API maintenance, and micro-automations) or Fractional Delivery Systems Partner (shipping one new automation sprint every month plus a monthly COO capacity and utilization review).

## Track Record & Impact
- Flagship Enterprise Case Study: Engineered and rolled out a custom Google Workspace capacity and resource planning system across 17 teams and 37 people (via our extended network), recovering roughly 16 hours per person monthly (~590 hours/month org-wide) previously spent on manual scheduling and spreadsheet maintenance.
- Built natively inside existing stacks (Google Workspace, Google Apps Script, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Slack, Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Airtable, Stripe) with zero incremental per-user licensing fees.
